entries.component: Front lower lateral link / forward control arm assembly (front lower "fore" link — the primary clunk source)
entries.repairRoleEvidence: Existing fixParts:0 must be reverified and keyed-merged.

existingFixParts.note: Fore link. Tesla sells it only as a complete arm assembly (bushing not available separately). Single PN fits LEFT or RIGHT on Model 3 (June-2017 through 2023). ~$180-230 OEM new; ~$90-150 used. Replace in pairs and follow with a four-wheel alignment. Fits the 2017-2024 issue years.
existingFixParts.component: Front lower lateral link / forward control arm assembly (front lower "fore" link — the primary clunk source)

existingFixParts.note: Aft/compliance link, driver (LH) side. Sold only as a complete assembly. Text-cited PN family 1044351-00-x = this LH compliance link. Supersessions 1044354-00-A / 2188354-10-B. Era-correct for 2017-2024 Model 3.
existingFixParts.component: Front lower compliance link / rear-aft link assembly — LEFT HAND

existingFixParts.note: Aft/compliance link, passenger (RH) side — the mirror of the LH 1044351-00-C. Bushing tears are common on this side (fore-aft loading). Complete-assembly only. Supersessions 1044356-00-C / 2188359-10-B.
existingFixParts.component: Front lower compliance link / rear-aft link assembly — RIGHT HAND

existingFixParts.note: Aftermarket upgrade alternative to buying whole arms: sealed spherical bearings press into the existing lateral/compliance links. Billet 6061-T6, made in North America; eliminates the torn-rubber clunk. REQUIRES a hydraulic press to install. No OEM PN (aftermarket). Also offered by Unplugged Perform
existingFixParts.component: Aftermarket solid/spherical front lower control arm bearing kit (press-in bushing replacement — MountainPass Performance

entries.component: epb release tool/connector
entries.repairRoleEvidence: Use the EPB release tool/connector to fully release a stuck caliper; if the shaft is seized or the motor is damaged, the park-brake caliper (or the caliper's park-brake motor) is replaced and the system re-calibrated.

existingFixParts.note: The small electric screw-drive motor bolted to the rear caliper that throws EPB_w052/EPB_w053 when it fails or the shaft corrodes/seizes. Independent shops often replace just this motor. Fits Model S (and X) 2012-2021. OEM ref 1021252-00-E (also cited as -00-F revision); EV Parts Online sells kit EV
existingFixParts.component: Rear parking-brake caliper actuator motor (integrated EPB drive motor) — the DIY-replaceable motor that fails/seizes, av

existingFixParts.note: Non-Performance S/X built after 2016-11-16 use the Mando rear integrated parking-brake caliper (1-caliper design). RH = 1078542-00-B, LH = 1078541-00-B (-01-B are the red-painted revisions). When the shaft seizes Tesla replaces the whole caliper, often both sides. Confirmed via Tesla service manual
existingFixParts.component: Rear integrated EPB caliper — Mando (single-piston integrated park-brake caliper, base Model S built after Nov 16, 2016)

existingFixParts.note: Earlier base Model S (2012-2016) and Performance cars use Brembo rear calipers with integrated EPB actuator. Rear Brembo e-brake caliper pair OEM 1021250-00-D (per Autobahn Parts). Replaced when the park-brake screw/shaft seizes and the motor swap won't cure it. Era-correct for 2013-2016; do NOT use
existingFixParts.component: Rear integrated e-brake caliper — Brembo (2012-2016 base Model S, LH/RH pair)

existingFixParts.note: Tesla service procedure specifies 2x new washers (1006309-00-A) when reconnecting the brake hose to the rear caliper. Consumable required only when the full caliper — not just the motor — is replaced. Verified from Tesla 'Brake Caliper - Rear' R&R manual.

existingFixParts.note: Tesla proc calls for Silaramic lubricant (1063021-00-A) on the caliper pad slides during caliper/motor service; the clean-and-lube step is what prevents the moisture/corrosion seizure from recurring. Permatex Silaramic is the equivalent retail product. Verified from Tesla service manual.
existingFixParts.component: Silaramic caliper lubricant (clean-and-lube service to prevent recurrence / on caliper pad slides at reassembly)

existingFixParts.note: Tesla EPB release tool (1134520-00-A) drives the park-brake motor to fully retract a caliper stuck in the applied position so the wheel/caliper can be serviced. entries.component: window regulator
entries.repairRoleEvidence: Replace the window regulator assembly (OEM), or install an upgraded billet-aluminum ferrule to cure the root-cause weak point at low cost

existingFixParts.note: Root-cause fix for the plastic-ferrule failure on the driver front door. OEM 6006551-00 has running-change suffixes across the 2012-2020 span (-E early, -G mid, -L later) — verify the exact suffix by VIN. Dorman 740-602 is the OE-FIX aftermarket unit with longer cable tensioners/deeper reel channels
existingFixParts.component: Front Left (driver) door window regulator & motor assembly

existingFixParts.note: Passenger-front counterpart. OEM 6006651-00 seen with -G (2012-2017) and -L (2016-2020) suffixes — match by VIN/year. Dorman 740-603 is the OE-FIX aftermarket equivalent. OEM ~$250-360; Dorman ~$90-120. Re-calibrate after service.

existingFixParts.component: Gen 3.0 exterior door handle assembly (retrofit unit, front LH) — full assembly replacement per Tesla TSB TN-17-11-001

entries.component: air strut/spring
entries.repairRoleEvidence: replacing a leaking air strut/spring or valve block to a new air suspension compressor

existingFixParts.note: Fits front L or R. OEM 1027361-00-G is the common revision for 2016-2020; early-build cars (before ~Oct 2016) used 1027361-00-E. This is the primary part when the leak/sag is at a front corner. 2021-2023 refresh cars use later revisions of the same base 1027361 number.
existingFixParts.component: Front air strut / air spring assembly (leaking corner sag repair)

existingFixParts.note: Fits rear L or R (Sep 2015-Feb 2021 coverage on -00-G). Use when a rear corner is the one dropping overnight. 2021-2023 refresh uses a later part (e.g. 1620462-00-A) — do NOT use that number on 2016-2020 cars.
existingFixParts.component: Rear air spring strut assembly (leaking corner sag repair)

existingFixParts.note: Compressor for weak build-pressure / high duty-cycle / freeze-failure. The Tesla compressor unit ships with the air dryer integrated and includes a new relay; the relay should be replaced with the compressor. Arnott P-3509 covers 2016-Oct 2019 Model X. Alt OEM 1044911-00-D is a shared Model S/X comp
existingFixParts.component: Air suspension compressor (with integrated air dryer + relay)

existingFixParts.note: Distributes air to each corner and holds the pressure sensor; replace when the block leaks/bleeds a corner down or fails to hold pressure. Same 1027919-00-B block is shared across Model S/X of this era.
existingFixParts.component: Air suspension solenoid valve block / manifold (with pressure sensor)

existingFixParts.note: Front RH = 1027946-00-A, front LH = 1027941-00-A. A faulty height sensor can mimic a leak by commanding bleed-down, so the FIX calls for a plausibility check before parts. Shared with Model S 2012-2021.
existingFixParts.component: Front ride-height sensor (rules out sensor-commanded bleed-down)

existingFixParts.note: Rear RH = 1027976-00-A, rear LH = 1027971-00-A. Diagnose alongside the front sensors when a corner drops but no physical leak is found. Shared Model S/X 2016-2021.
existingFixParts.component: Rear ride-height sensor (rules out sensor-commanded bleed-down)

entries.repairRoleEvidence: replacing a leaking air strut/spring or valve block to a new air suspension compressor

existingFixParts.note: Fits front L or R. OEM 1027361-00-G is the common revision for 2016-2020; early-build cars (before ~Oct 2016) used 1027361-00-E. This is the primary part when the leak/sag is at a front corner. 2021-2023 refresh cars use later revisions of the same base 1027361 number.
existingFixParts.component: Front air strut / air spring assembly (leaking corner sag repair)

existingFixParts.note: Fits rear L or R (Sep 2015-Feb 2021 coverage on -00-G). Use when a rear corner is the one dropping overnight. 2021-2023 refresh uses a later part (e.g. 1620462-00-A) — do NOT use that number on 2016-2020 cars.
existingFixParts.component: Rear air spring strut assembly (leaking corner sag repair)

existingFixParts.note: Compressor for weak build-pressure / high duty-cycle / freeze-failure. The Tesla compressor unit ships with the air dryer integrated and includes a new relay; the relay should be replaced with the compressor. Arnott P-3509 covers 2016-Oct 2019 Model X. Alt OEM 1044911-00-D is a shared Model S/X comp
existingFixParts.component: Air suspension compressor (with integrated air dryer + relay)

existingFixParts.note: Distributes air to each corner and holds the pressure sensor; replace when the block leaks/bleeds a corner down or fails to hold pressure. Same 1027919-00-B block is shared across Model S/X of this era.
existingFixParts.component: Air suspension solenoid valve block / manifold (with pressure sensor)

existingFixParts.note: Front RH = 1027946-00-A, front LH = 1027941-00-A. A faulty height sensor can mimic a leak by commanding bleed-down, so the FIX calls for a plausibility check before parts. Shared with Model S 2012-2021.
existingFixParts.component: Front ride-height sensor (rules out sensor-commanded bleed-down)

existingFixParts.note: Rear RH = 1027976-00-A, rear LH = 1027971-00-A. Diagnose alongside the front sensors when a corner drops but no physical leak is found. Shared Model S/X 2016-2021.
existingFixParts.component: Rear ride-height sensor (rules out sensor-commanded bleed-down)
aftermarketXref: TRQ front & rear leveling sensor kit
OEM S/X rear sensor w/ bracket

existingFixParts.note: Fits front L or R. OEM 1027361-00-G is the common revision for 2016-2020; early-build cars (before ~Oct 2016) used 1027361-00-E. This is the primary part when the leak/sag is at a front corner. 2021-2023 refresh cars use later revisions of the same base 1027361 number.
existingFixParts.component: Front air strut / air spring assembly (leaking corner sag repair)

existingFixParts.note: Fits rear L or R (Sep 2015-Feb 2021 coverage on -00-G). Use when a rear corner is the one dropping overnight. 2021-2023 refresh uses a later part (e.g. 1620462-00-A) — do NOT use that number on 2016-2020 cars.
existingFixParts.component: Rear air spring strut assembly (leaking corner sag repair)

existingFixParts.note: Compressor for weak build-pressure / high duty-cycle / freeze-failure. The Tesla compressor unit ships with the air dryer integrated and includes a new relay; the relay should be replaced with the compressor. Arnott P-3509 covers 2016-Oct 2019 Model X. Alt OEM 1044911-00-D is a shared Model S/X comp
existingFixParts.component: Air suspension compressor (with integrated air dryer + relay)

existingFixParts.note: Distributes air to each corner and holds the pressure sensor; replace when the block leaks/bleeds a corner down or fails to hold pressure. Same 1027919-00-B block is shared across Model S/X of this era.
existingFixParts.component: Air suspension solenoid valve block / manifold (with pressure sensor)

existingFixParts.note: Front RH = 1027946-00-A, front LH = 1027941-00-A. A faulty height sensor can mimic a leak by commanding bleed-down, so the FIX calls for a plausibility check before parts. Shared with Model S 2012-2021.
existingFixParts.component: Front ride-height sensor (rules out sensor-commanded bleed-down)

existingFixParts.note: Rear RH = 1027976-00-A, rear LH = 1027971-00-A. Diagnose alongside the front sensors when a corner drops but no physical leak is found. Shared Model S/X 2016-2021.
existingFixParts.component: Rear ride-height sensor (rules out sensor-commanded bleed-down)
aftermarketXref: TRQ front & rear leveling sensor kit
OEM S/X rear sensor w/ bracket
